text:
Eli: hi everyone — i'm Eli, just started as a product designer today. quick unblock please: Figma invite shows 'request access' and I can't find the current PRD folder in Notion. also curious where we keep prior usability test scripts and consent language. Who's the go-to?

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Eli :tada:  Invite attempted to eli@redwood.ai. If blocked after 5m run `/resend_invite figma eli@redwood.ai` or reply "manual add" and an admin will assist. Product PRDs live at https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Docs-PRDs-11aa. Usability scripts: Notion > Research > Playbooks > Usability. Consent templates: Research > Ops > Consent-Templates. Join channels: #design, #product, #research-ops, #device-lab.

Eli: tried resend, still stuck on request screen in Chrome.

Nora: hey Eli, welcome! DM'd you — i'll add you to the Figma org manually. in the meantime, open Figma in incognito or try another account if you have a personal figma session. Do you want access to the "Product Design" team only or also "Redwood Systems"?

Eli: Product Design only is fine for now. thanks Nora.

Product Onboarding Bot: manual add in progress by Nora. If you see any missing libraries after this, run: `Plugins -> Team Libraries -> Refresh`.

Eli: ok can open it now 44d I see a file called "RDW Components" and a FigJam called "Onboarding Playbook". Are tokens published to Figma or maintained separately in the Design System Notion page?

Diego: tokens are source-of-truth in Notion under Design System > Tokens (we export to JSON and use the Tokens plugin to push to Figma). If you need the export script access it's in the infra repo. I can republish if something's stale.

Eli: perfect. another onboarding question: where do PMs drop the feature brief / PRD lead for a new epic? sometimes i see links in Slack but want canonical.

Maya: welcome Eli! PM here — we keep canonical PRDs in Notion (link above). Each PRD page has a "Design" section with context, MoSCoW prioritization, and links to the Linear epic. For handoff we add a "Design Handoff" checklist that includes: redlines, tokens used, prototype link, and acceptance criteria. If you prefer, I can show the handoff template in a 10-min sync.

Eli: yes please — a quick walkthrough would help. Also curious about user research artifacts: where do we store recordings and transcriptions?

Maya: recordings and transcripts go to S3 under `prod-research/artifacts` and we link them on the study Notion page. For access request: SSO -> AWS -> Request role `research-read`. For external vendor screenshots we use Drive; links live on the study page.

Nora: FYI we have weekly "Design Ops" drop-in on Tuesdays 3pm for tool questions (tokens, prototyping, device lab bookings). Device lab booking is via the Device Lab calendar (link in #device-lab) — if you need a Pixel/iphone to run tests ping that channel.

Diego: +1 on the device lab. Also, if you plan to run moderated tests we require the consent template to be attached and the recruiting screener in the study page. Small guerrilla testing is ok without full IRB but we still use the standard consent phrasing for data usage.

Eli: got it. small process ask: how do I file a quick bug with the Design System (something misaligned)?

Nora: open a ticket in the Design System board in Linear with label `ds-bug`, include Figma frame + screenshot + repro steps. We triage weekly. If it's blocking a release DM me and tag `urgent`.

Maya: i'll add you to the current roadmap review doc and the weekly roadmap sync invite. The roadmap is split into quarters in Notion + a high-level slide deck in Drive: Product Roadmap Q2.

Eli: thanks! last tiny thing — do we prefer FigJam for whiteboarding or Miro?

Diego: FigJam for lightweight team workshops and alignment. Miro is used for longer research affinity mapping and partner workshops. Both links live in the Playbooks page.

Eli: amazing, appreciate the help. can we close once invites and Notion access are confirmed?

Product Onboarding Bot: checklist: Figma access  confirmed; Notion PRD + Research playbooks  link shared; S3 research artifacts  request instructions shared; Device lab  join #device-lab; Linear DS board  link shared.

Eli: all green here. thanks everyone 44f
